summary: Transocean Ltd. (RIG) disclosed an 8-K regarding a support agreement with Famatown Finance Limited for board nomination rights. Transocean agreed to nominate Kristian Johansen for election at its extraordinary general meeting, contingent on shareholder approval and consummation of its acquisition of Valaris. The agreement includes re-nomination rights for two years, standstill and voting covenants, and an observer right if Johansen is not on the board. No financial terms, share price, or premium are stated. Watch for shareholder vote on the Valaris acquisition and its impact on board composition.
